notes.labels: Every image must render its `label` visibly (badge or caption) wherever it appears, including lightbox. Concept art is never described as gameplay.
notes.originals: originals/ are byte-identical copies of the sources (SHA-256 recorded). Sources were never modified.
notes.web: web/ holds stripped sRGB AVIF (q55), WebP (q80) and progressive JPEG (q82) per width; serve via <picture> with AVIF > WebP > JPEG and width/height attributes from this manifest.
notes.vault_embeds: The original concept note embeds Generated image 1/2/3/4 1/5.png. A recursive search of /home/teknetik/Documents/teknetik (and the whole filesystem) found no files with those names, so they could not be inspected or used.
notes.excluded: Older (pre-1 Oct) screenshots, Sep 7 refs/ and concept_art/ frames from the retired browser era were excluded as obsolete. hall_district street-concept-a (unaccepted signage) and west gate concept (heavy lettering) not selected.
